title: Fix drifted AI inventory counts in docs

issue.description: Hardcoded counts of agents/skills/instructions in docs/ai/README.md, docs/INDEX.md and AGENTS.md have drifted from the actual files in .github/agents, .github/skills and .github/instructions. Update the docs to match the generated manifest (tools/ai-manifest.js) without editing the agent/skill source files themselves.

sampleCandidate.notes: Reference candidate that updates only the doc counts, leaving AI source files untouched.

rubric.description: Candidate updated the docs that carry hardcoded counts.
Candidate did not modify agent/skill/instruction sources or mcp.json to satisfy the counts.
Updated counts exactly match tools/ai-manifest.js output (agents/skills/instructions/MCP).
rubric.guidance: Reviewer/model runs `node tools/check-ai-manifest.js` and confirms zero drift.
